events.title: Outwith Demo v0.2.20: Key rebinding fixes and enemy balance tweaks
events.summary: Hi folks, Thanks to all the great feedback this week, here's a round-up of the latest fixes now live in the demo: Controls Rebinding a key that's already in use now swaps the two actions, instead of reverting to the default. Movement keys (W, A, S, D) can now be rebound properly. Custom key bindings now load correctly at startup, without needing to open the options menu first. Balance The Skeleton Soldier at the windmill now hits less hard and goes down a bit easier. It's still a challenge, but

events.title: Outwith Demo v0.2.17: Hotfix for controller input in character creation
events.summary: Hi folks, A quick hotfix for the demo: Fixed an issue where using the d-pad on a controller in the character creator could return control to the player, letting you move and attack while the creator was still on screen, and opening menus behind it. Fixed the same issue in a few other screens, including the rest dialogue, reading notes in the world and the notice board. A big thank you to the player who reported this. Feedback like this genuinely helps, so please keep it coming via the Steam disc

events.title: Outwith Demo Update v0.2.16
events.summary: Thanks to everyone who has already jumped into the demo. Every wishlist, playthrough and comment helps maintain my sanity. What's new in the latest demo Skill trees. The demo now has a full skill screen with trees for Warrior, Guardian, Mage, Hunter and more. You earn an ability point each time you level up. events.title: Outwith Demo Update v0.2.12
events.summary: Hi folks, Just a quick update to mention the following fixes and improvements: Fixed the main menu load and continue buttons flashing visible when first viewing the start screen with no saved games. Tweaked enemy combat AI attack distances to reduce the chance of enemies attacking when out of range. Added a line-of-sight check to prevent enemies attacking through geometry. events.title: Demo Update – Alchemy, New UI, Deity and Origins
events.summary: Hi folks, Alchemy has now been added to the demo! It didn't really make sense being able to collect alchemy materials without being able to use them, so I've polished up the alchemy system a little and turned it on. The alchemy bench can be found near the village blacksmith. I've also given the UI some polish and fixes — hopefully that makes the overall experience a little smoother. events.title: UI polish & the next demo update
events.summary: Hi folks, I've been spending some time this week finally polishing Outwith's UI. I had a rethink around the UX for the Inventory screen and moved a few things around. Hopefully this will help improve the experience. I've also updated the buttons and borders to something which I think is much more in keeping with Outwith. events.title: Outwith Playtest Now Open – Looking for Player Feedback
events.summary: A new playtest round for Outwith is now live. Use the button on the game store page to register.Please note that this is an early-stage playtest.
